metadata.title: Nakamasu et al. (2009) Zebrafish Three-Variable Pigment-Cell Reaction-Diffusion, Laser-Ablation Regeneration & leopard (cx41.8) Spot-to-Stripe Morphospace Reference Dataset

sources.citation: Nakamasu A, Takahashi G, Kanbe A, Kondo S (2009). Interactions between zebrafish pigment cells responsible for the generation of Turing patterns. PNAS 106(21):8429-8434.
Yamaguchi M, Yoshimoto E, Kondo S (2007). Pattern regulation in the stripe of zebrafish suggests an underlying dynamic and autonomous mechanism. PNAS 104(12):4790-4793.
Watanabe M, Iwashita M, Ishii M, Kurachi Y, Kawakami A, Kondo S, Okada N (2006). Spot pattern of leopard Danio is caused by mutation in the zebrafish connexin41.8 gene. EMBO Reports 7(9):893-897.
Inaba M, Yamanaka H, Kondo S (2012). Pigment pattern formation by contact-dependent depolarization. Science 335(6069):677.

danio_rerio_adult_flank.species: Danio rerio (Adult wild-type zebrafish right lateral profile showing 4-5 dark melanophore stripes alternating with yellow/iridescent xanthophore-iridophore interstripes across trunk and caudal fin)
danio_rerio_adult_flank.author: Marrabbio2 / Wikimedia Commons

nakamasu_2009_three_cell_rd_system.section: Nakamasu et al. (2009) PNAS 106:8429-8434 Fig. 4D, Fig. 5 & SI Text Eqs. (1)-(6)

governing_pde.u_eq: du/dt = clip(a_u*u + b_u*v + d_u*w + e_u, 0, U_max) - c_u*u + D_u * Lap(u)
governing_pde.v_eq: dv/dt = clip(a_v*u + b_v*v + d_v*w + e_v, 0, V_max) - c_v*v + D_v * Lap(v)
governing_pde.w_eq: dw/dt = clip(a_w*u + b_w*v + d_w*w + e_w, 0, W_max) - c_w*w + D_w * Lap(w)

state_variables.w: Long-range diffusible survival/signaling factor mediating xanthophore-to-melanophore cross-stripe support

governing_pde.boundary_condition: Zero-flux Neumann boundary conditions on dorsoventral and anteroposterior domain boundaries, with optional horizontal myoseptum / pioneer iridophore X0 interstripe cue along y = L_y / 2

laser_ablation_and_leopard_morphospace.section: Nakamasu et al. (2009) Figs. 2, 3, 5 & Watanabe et al. (2006) EMBO Rep. 7:893-897

laser_ablation_experiments.perturbation: Selective laser ablation of xanthophore interstripes X0 and X1V flanking melanophore stripe 1V
laser_ablation_experiments.biological_outcome: Melanophore survival drops sharply (>50% loss within 7-14 days), proving long-range xanthophore -> melanophore survival requirement (b_w > 0, d_u > 0)

laser_ablation_experiments.perturbation: Wide-area rectangular ablation across dorsal/ventral stripes vs isolated central patch
laser_ablation_experiments.biological_outcome: Intact anterior/posterior boundary stripes guide horizontal stripe regeneration, whereas unguided central regions form labyrinthine/spot Turing patterns

leopard_cx418_morphospace_regimes.allele: Danio rerio wild-type (WT + horizontal myoseptum X0 pioneer cue)
